Mushanduri Wezvinyorwa WeAI Wemahara Wemabhuku

Ili chishandiso chemahara chekushandura zvinyorwa online chinofambiswa nemhando huru dzemitauro. Isa mafaera eSRT, VTT kana ASS woshandura zvinyorwa pakati peChirungu, Chinarisi, ChiJapanese, ChiKorean, ChiSpanish, ChiFrench uye mimwe mitauro inodarika 15+. Hapana kunyoresa, hapana kuiswa, hapana watermark — zvibude mubrowser wobva watanga kushandura. Data yezvinyorwa inorara mubrowser yako kunze kwekunge wabvumira shanduro yegore.

Zvinhu zvikuru: Kuongorora kweSRT, VTT neASS nekushandura kweAI, kubatanidzwa kwemitsara kwakangwara (kana mutsara mumwe uchipfuura pamusoro pezvinyorwa zvakawanda, zvinyorwa zvinobatanidzwa, zvinoshandurwa,ozoparadzaniswa zvakare pamusoro penguva yepakutanga), kurongwa kwenguva, kuputirwa kwemitsara otomatiki kune zvinyorwa zveCJK neWestern, kubviswa kwemashoko asina basa, kubata mazwi akasarudzika, uye masitaera ekushandura anogona kusarudzwa. Tumira mafaera akajairika eSRT, VTT, ASS kana TXT akagadzirira kuiswa pamusoro pevhidhiyo yako.

Ndiani anozvishandisa: vaturikiri vevhidhiyo, vanyori veYouTube nevaturikiri, vadzidzi vemitauro, mapoka ezvinyorwa nezvikwata zvinoda kugadzirisa zviri mukati mevhidhiyo nekukurumidza.
